title: Winged orange glowing beings over skywatch groups

tellings.quote: And we get things that appear to have wings, orange glowing beings, as many as 20 at the time, fly 25 ft over our head

plain: At skywatches, gatherings where people watch the night sky together hoping to see something, glowing orange beings that seem to have wings have flown about 25 feet over the group's heads, as many as 20 at a time. Chris Bledsoe, a man the episode says NASA studies because he seems to draw UFOs to him, tells Michels this from his own skywatches.
